popularity.head_torso_tail: head top 20%, torso middle 60%, tail bottom 20% by FIT interaction count with item_id tie-break

user_cohorts.history_length: FIT_VISIBLE count quartiles with deterministic boundary values
user_cohorts.tail_preference: quartiles of FIT history share in frozen tail items
user_cohorts.niche_preference: quartiles of median FIT interaction popularity of history, low median is more niche
user_cohorts.history_diversity: quartiles of Shannon entropy over permitted item tag categories in FIT history

non_accuracy.ItemCoverage@20: unique recommended items at rank<=20 divided by candidate-eligible catalog size
non_accuracy.AveragePopularity@20: mean log1p FIT interaction count over top-20 exposures
non_accuracy.TailPercentage@20: share of top-20 exposures assigned to frozen bottom-20%-popularity items
non_accuracy.exposure_Gini: Gini coefficient of item top-20 exposure counts including zero-exposure eligible items
non_accuracy.exposure_HHI: sum of squared item exposure shares
non_accuracy.exposure_entropy: Shannon entropy of nonzero item exposure shares
non_accuracy.intra_list_diversity: mean pairwise cosine distance among top-20 items using frozen L2-normalized permitted concatenated image/text/tag representation
non_accuracy.personalization: 1 minus mean top-20 Jaccard overlap over 10000 deterministic SHA256-selected eligible user pairs
